    StartersFaculty party cranberry cheese ballCheddar and cream cheese ball with cranberries, rolled in walnutsHow to make it250g cream cheese, soft150g vintage cheddar, grated60g dried cranberries, chopped1 small bunch chives, chopped1/2 tsp garlic powder70g walnuts1 small bunch parsley, chopped200g crackersBeat the cream cheese with the cheddar, cranberries, chives and garlic powder.Shape into a ball, wrap in cling film and chill until firm.Toast the walnuts in a dry pan, chop finely and mix with the parsley.Roll the ball in the walnut mix until coated and serve with crackers.North Pole pumpkin and sage soupRoast pumpkin soup with crisp sage and toasted pepitasHow to make it1.2kg pumpkin, peeled and cubed1 onion, quartered2 tbsp olive oil1 L vegetable stock100ml thickened cream30g butter1 sage40g pepitasHeat the oven to 200°C. Roast the pumpkin and onion with the oil and salt for 35 minutes.Blend with the stock until smooth, then heat through with the cream. Season.Fry the sage leaves in the butter until crisp and toast the pepitas in the same pan.Serve topped with the sage butter and pepitas.MainsMrs. Claus roast chickenThyme butter roast chicken with potatoes and carrotsHow to make it1 whole chicken40g butter, soft1 small bunch thyme800g potatoes, halved3 carrots, cut into chunksRub the chicken with the butter, thyme and salt.Roast at 200°C.Add the potatoes and carrots to the tray and keep roasting.Rest the chicken before carving.Mother Nature's maple roast vegetablesMaple pumpkin, carrot and parsnip for 33,000 Easter Bunny offspring.How to make it800g pumpkin, cut in wedges3 carrots, halved lengthways3 parsnips, halved lengthways3 tbsp olive oil3 tbsp maple syrup4 sprigs of thyme40g pecans, choppedCut the pumpkin, carrots and parsnips.Toss with the oil and salt and roast at 210°C until browned and tender.Drizzle with the maple, add the thyme and pecans and roast until sticky.SweetsToy Santa candy cane browniesChocolate brownies with white chocolate and crushed candy caneHow to make it200g dark chocolate150g butter250g caster sugar3 eggs1/2 tsp peppermint extract100g plain flour30g cocoa powder120g white chocolate4 candy canes, crushedMelt the dark chocolate with the butter. Whisk in the sugar, eggs, peppermint extract and a pinch of salt, then fold in the flour and cocoa.Spread into a lined 20cm square tin and bake at 170°C until just set.Cool completely.Melt the white chocolate, spread over the top and scatter with crushed candy canes.Chill, then cut into squares.North Pole elf cookiesButtery cut-out cookies iced red and greenHow to make it200g butter, soft350g icing sugar1 egg yolk300g plain flour1 pack food colouring (red and green)Beat the butter with some of the icing sugar, add the egg yolk and flour and mix to a dough.Chill the dough.Roll out and cut stars and trees.Bake at 170°C and cool completely.Mix the remaining icing sugar with water, tint red and green and ice the cookies.DrinksAbby's designer bean peppermint cocoaHot chocolate with peppermint, whipped cream and a candy caneHow to make it1 L full cream milk2 tbsp caster sugar100g milk chocolate, chopped50g dark chocolate, chopped1 tbsp cocoa powder1/4 tsp peppermint extract150ml thickened cream, whipped4 candy canesHeat the milk with the sugar until steaming but not boiling.Whisk in the chocolates and cocoa until smooth and frothy, then stir in the peppermint extract.Pour into mugs, top with whipped cream and hang a candy cane on each mug to stir.Sparkling apple and gingerRaised at the Mrs. Claus wedding.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
